Kuch log machharon ke liye sau guna tak zyada tasty hote hain.
Teri skin ka tel aur bacteria milke ek smell banate hain. Machhar usi ke peeche aate hain.
Toh main aaj se do baar nahaunga.
Koi farak nahi. Shampoo badal, khana badal... teen saal baad bhi wahi smell.
Paas hi baith. Tere hote, mujhe koi nahi kaatta.
